resources.string: HTTPS URL of your yt-fifo server, e.g. https://audio.example.org. Plain HTTP servers need an HTTPS reverse proxy. When set, \"Play on home audio\" and \"Queue on home audio\" appear in the stream long-press menu and the Cast picker.
Enter an HTTPS server URL without credentials, query parameters or a fragment, or leave it empty to disable home audio.
